params.name: mid
params.description: The merchant ID associated with the Tyro account. Used to identify the merchant whose settlement data is being retrieved.

params.name: settlementDate
params.description: Requested settlement date (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be within the past 3 years.

items.docs: This endpoint allows you to retrieve BECs-cleared settlement details for a specific merchant on a given date.

params.name: mid
params.description: The merchant ID associated with the Tyro account. Used to identify the merchant whose transaction data is being retrieved.

params.name: transactionDate
params.description: The date (YYYY-MM-DD) that the terminal has processed the requested transactions. Must be within the past 3 years.

params.name: limit
params.description: Specifies the amount of results to be retrieved.

params.name: page
params.description:
Specify the page to retrieve.

Page-numbering is based on the value of "limit". If limit=5, then page=1 will display the hits from 1 to 5, page=3 will display the hits from 11 to 15.

Page numbers start at 1.

A request for a non-existing page will yield 0 results.

items.docs: This endpoint allows you to retrieve a merchant's list of transactions for a given terminal business day.
